doc: Air-defense / ground-unit family mapping from FreeFalcon's AIRDEF_* indices (src/sim/include/dofsnswitches.h). Index 0 is the radar dish sweep — carried by every air-defense model and bound to the continuous radar.dish_spin channel (driven by the rig's spinner pass). The remaining indices (1..5: dish elevation, turret yaw/pitch) stay unmapped until that part of the ground-unit rig exists, so they export as unknown.N tags.
